criteria.text: Reduction of excess abdominal fat in HIV-infected patients with lipodystrophy.

notes: Partial encoding from AK Egrifta (tesamorelin), a growth hormone releasing factor (GRF) analog, Criteria Version 1 (Last updated/Approved 11/18/2011). The existing ingest effective_date 2025-03-01 is retained; the PDF version date is distinct.

Encoded: closed indication for reduction of excess abdominal fat in HIV-infected patients with lipodystrophy and HIV-positive status (the only numbered approval criterion). The PDF specifies no age, specialty, or other approval gates.
Coverage may be approved for up to 3 months. Reauthorization may be approved pending documentation of clinical improvement of lipodystrophy; reauthorization remains notes only, not predicated.
Dispensing limit: 30-day supply of medication; quantity is unspecified and not a numeric predicate.

FDA limitations of use (notes only): not indicated for weight loss management (weight neutral effect). Long-term cardiovascular benefit and safety have not been studied. There are no data to support compliance with anti-retroviral therapies in HIV-positive patients taking Egrifta.
No Egrifta or tesamorelin match was found in the ingested PDL; pdl_status remains unknown. No evaluate()-linked peers are specified; alternatives is empty.
